Terms of use

Version date: October 2, 2026 · Operator: Jeremy (제레미)

MenuNori is a free educational simulation. Using its basket or confirmation screen does not place an order or create a payment obligation.

Practice content

All restaurant prices and menu configurations on the practice screen are fictional. Food images are illustrative AI-generated artwork. Restaurants may use different ingredients, prices, labels, service arrangements, and ordering screens.

Use current information when traveling

Check actual menu details and final prices with the restaurant before placing a real order. For allergies and dietary restrictions, ask about ingredients and preparation at that restaurant. The game’s spice labels are not ingredient or allergy assurances.

Content and corrections

MenuNori’s interface, explanations, and practice missions are original project content. Linked resources belong to their respective publishers. We may update examples, translations, and features. Independent native-speaker verification is still pending for this first version.

Your browser data

Your completion setting is local to your browser. See the privacy page for details and a way to clear them. No account, audio upload, or real payment is part of this service.

Operator

Jeremy (제레미) operates this project. A public contact address will be added before a public advertising launch.
